turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is your PayLite training coach. We'll do a quick five-question check on the Soundbox. Ready?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: First question. What does the Soundbox cost the merchant?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Ninety-nine rupees per month rental. Very affordable for any shop.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Question two. Which payment types does it support?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It accepts UPI and all debit and credit cards, so the merchant never loses a customer.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Question three. What documents does a merchant need to sign up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: PAN card, bank account, and a GST certificate. GST is compulsory for onboarding.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Question four. A merchant says, 'I already have a free QR sticker, why should I pay for a Soundbox?' How do you respond?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Great question. I'd tell them the QR sticker is silent. With the Soundbox, every payment is announced, so there's no fake-screenshot fraud and the staff don't need to keep checking the phone. It pays for itself the first time it stops one fraud.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Last one. When does the merchant get the money in their bank account?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The money settles the next working day, T plus one, directly in their account.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's the end of the check, Neha. You'll get feedback by message.
